description:
ADR-003 changed what "tuned" and "notuning" physically mean on ClickHouse
(session pack moved to the tuned path; tuned DDL now actually renders).
Bundles record benchbox_version but nothing semantically marks which
tuning-policy generation produced a run, so third-party bundles spanning
the seam can be compared without any warning. Add a compact
tuning_policy_generation marker to the bundle tuning block (e.g. "adr3-v1";
emitted by result capture, constant defined beside the ledger vocabulary),
ingest it in the explorer, and have ComparabilityReceipt warn when compared
runs carry different generations (absent = pre-seam, treated as its own
generation). The seed corpus is already clean (pre-seam tuned bundles were
dropped in #1185); this protects third-party submissions.

anti_patterns.dont: overload benchbox_version parsing as the seam signal

preserves.behavior: Facet MATCHING unchanged (warning-only, like the mechanisms warning) unless a future ADR says otherwise

prior_art.concept: results-explorer/src/components/ComparabilityReceipt.tsx mechanisms warning (#1182): warning-only comparability signal pattern - reuse

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/results tests/unit/scripts/explorer_pipeline -q -k 'generation or seam or policy'
verifications.description: New bundle carries the marker; receipt warns on cross-generation tuned pairs

work_units.evidence: New benchbox/core/tuning/policy_generation.py TUNING_POLICY_GENERATION='adr-003' (EXPLICIT marker per ADR-3, NOT benchbox_version). schema.py emits tuning_policy_generation in _build_tuning_summary + build_tuning_payload (only when tuning present, next to hashes). docs/reference/result-formats.md documents it.
work_units.summary: Emit tuning_policy_generation in the bundle tuning block + companion; document in result-formats.md

work_units.evidence: explorer_pipeline transformer._tuning_policy_generation (verbatim, legacy->None) into manifest+detail; models display-only field; duckdb_builder column+view+INSERT. TS ComparabilityReceipt buildTuningPolicyGenerationField: WARNS (never blocks) when >=2 tuned runs span different generations; absent='pre-seam' (two legacy=no warning). Mirrors cross-mechanism warning. types.ts/duckdbQueries.ts wiring.
work_units.summary: Explorer ingest + receipt warning across differing generations (absent = pre-seam generation)

work_units.evidence: test_tuning_provenance_export (marker in summary+companion; omitted no-tuning); test_transformer (verbatim ingest manifest+detail; None legacy); test_duckdb_browser_contract (column); ComparabilityReceipt.test.tsx (warns cross-gen; no warn same-gen/both-pre-seam). 59 passed (-k generation/seam/policy); 1041 passed broad; ruff/ty clean. FACET MATCHING UNCHANGED (0 refs in ranking/facetMatching/facetModel). Legacy loads unchanged. npm verifies in CI (node_modules absent).
work_units.summary: Tests both sides; legacy bundles unaffected except the receipt note
